eventMetadata.context_description: Recent forecasts from the Pakistan Meteorological Department and models like those referenced by AccuWeather place Karachi's August 4 maximum near seasonal norms of 31–33 °C, reflecting the southwest monsoon’s influence on humidity and cloud cover that typically caps daytime peaks despite above-normal temperature outlooks for Sindh. Below-normal rainfall projections for the month reduce evaporative cooling but have not yet shifted guidance toward extremes above 34 °C, keeping trader consensus centered on 32–33 °C outcomes. Historical August averages of 31–32 °C and current short-range model runs showing stable steering patterns reinforce this positioning ahead of final observational data.
